label: Get through the exile winter
description: Flanders is closed to the house — not by a signed order anybody can be sued over, which is why it cannot be argued with. Danzig, and four months of reading your own correspondence.

label: Get out of the Crimea before the fleet does
description: Buy what Caffa's frightened are selling, and have the ship back at Danzig before the Ottoman squadron arrives. The consul's own count of it is for sale. The window is 34 weeks from the day the city is opened.

label: Take the Persian silk licence, once
description: The cheapest raw silk in the world, from a court the Ottomans have already beaten and Venice has spent four years failing to help. Worth one voyage. There will not be a second.

label: Put the papers in date order
description: Five documents from five countries, none of which proves anything alone. Father Moriz will assemble them if there is anything to assemble.

label: Survive what happens to Burgundy
description: The duke is at war with the Swiss and losing. Decide what the house's Burgundian paper is worth before the fifth of January decides for you.

label: Go home
description: The ban lapses because the man behind it dies. Nobody rescinds it; the customs simply stop being attentive.

label: The passages west
description: Caffa's Genoese were selling passages as briskly as furs, for the same reason. Doesn't gate the chapter — just marks whether the hold carried people.
